texts.zh:
[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上一个大型定居点的子个体们今天意外地爆发了一场冲突。我们的特工在伪装成当地低级子个体时误用了错误的信息素，并引发了拥挤踩踏事件。[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]蜂巢似乎对我们提前准备的信息素格外敏感。但如果继续在当地定居点之间编排这样的爆炸性交互，我们应该会学到不少东西。

显然，我们的存在本身正危害到[from.GetName]行动的进行。我们下次再发送任何信号都必须做到万无一失。
texts.en:
The drones of a major colony on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] were unexpectedly roused for battle today. Our agents mistakenly applied the wrong pheromone when trying to pass off as local menial drones, which lead to a stampede. The [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] hive appears unusually sensitive to our pre-prepared pheromones. If we orchestrate further explosive interactions between local colonies, there could be much to learn.

What is clear is that our presence is endangering the [from.GetName] Operation. Whatever signal we send next, it must be the right one.

label.zh: 研究他们对受控释放荷尔蒙的反应。
label.en: Study their reaction to controlled pheromone releases.

tooltips.zh: 增大在我们的谍报行动过程中[from.target.GetName]获得£awareness£觉醒的风险。
tooltips.en: Increased risk of the [from.target.GetName] gaining £awareness£ Awareness during our Espionage Operations.

label.en: Keep a lid on the pheromones.

tooltips.zh: 调配更多资源，确保我们的特工完成任务，避免进一步发生意外的风险。
tooltips.en: Assign more resources so our agents can fulfill the mission without risking any more incidents.

label.zh: 我们就坚持一下做到底。
label.en: We are committed to seeing this through.
